notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.notes:
Yo fellow snails!

Join us on Discord for fun community events: https://discord.com/invite/willyousnail

Snail on and see you around! :)
Jonas

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.notes:
Yo, fellow snails! 

This update is all about addressing some of the most common sources of frustration for new players. For example traps can no longer spawn out out of view and some unhealthy difficulty spikes in the lower two difficulty settings have been ironed out a bit. We got Steam trading cards now and tons of other little polish and quality of life improvements. Minor spoiler warning! If you haven't played the game already, better stop here.


Quality of Life:

 The game has Steam trading cards now!
 Added F11 as fullscreen / windowed hotkey
 Destructible blocks now show clearer warning when dropping.
 In Tower Defense level you can see which enemies are coming up next now.
 TD turrets show their range when you stand next to them.
 Basketball shows a dotted aim assist line to make it easier to learn and master.
 Additional sound effects for puzzle levels
 Snowman mafia got more reliable speedrun strat
 Localization improved & updated


Balancing changes:

 Traps can no longer spawn offscreen!
 Conveyor Belt speed lowered from (8 / 6.66 / 5.33 / 4) to (8 / 6 / 4 / 2)
 Overall amount of trap spawns reduced from (130% / 100% / 70% / 40%) to (130% / 100% / 66% / 33%)
 Reduced spike spawns in some early levels on the lowest two difficulties by an additional 25% (extremely easy) and 50% (infinitely easy)
 A16 spike probability increased by 50%
 First boss movement speed decreased from (125% / 100% / 75% / 50%) to (125% / 100% / 70% / 40%)
 Dance mini-game gives an additional grace period of 0.33 sec on infinitely easy and 0.16 sec on extremely easy for you to press a button.
 In laser room there will always at least be one laser active at a time. On lowest difficulty you can no longer get lucky by not having a single laser spawn.
 Disco Boss HP lowered from (800 / 800 / 800 / 800) to (800 / 800 / 700 / 600)
 When underwater your guns have about 20% and 40% longer range on the lower two difficulties.
 Mama Squid HP increased from (900 / 750 / 600 / 450) to (900 / 750 / 750 / 750)
 Your snail glow disappears while shelly is near Mama Squid's ink.
 The core in tower defense levels can take a few small hits before breaking.
 After re-enableing a turret in a TD level it has a 10 sec protection against being deactivated by an enemy.
 TD Jammers have a 5 sec cooldown after disabling a turret.
 Helpy starts out with (150% / 140% / 130% / 120%) battery charging speed but every time he charges, he loses charging speed all the way down to 50%. This stops the fight from going on indefinitely.
 Dronelly HP reduced from (2500 / 2000 / 1500 / 1000) to (2500 / 1500 / 1250 / 1000)
 Dronelly heat seeking missile speed reduced from (1 / 0.75 / 0.5 / 0.25) to (1 / 0.65 / 0.45 / 0.25)


Bug fixes:

 There was a bug that allowed you to glitch into the next level while going back to level select. This is fixed now.
 Due to a bug Squid was way more talkative than he was supposed to. This is resolved now. No worries, he still talks more than enough.
 Basketball softlock fixed (again)


Join us on Discord: https://discord.com/invite/willyousnail

Hope you enjoy! Snail on!
Jonas :)

notes.title: Patch 1.21
notes.notes:
Hey, the first little patch is out! :)

Changes:
➤ I created some cool Will You Snail themed Steam profile pictures for you. Check them out in profile / edit profile / avatar.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35367160/6f370f2303e7532fdbc831244ce2947e252c60d1.png

➤ Reworked save / load system for better stability and redundancy. The already super rare save file wipes should be even rarer if not impossible now. Also remember that if you accidentally delete your save file in the save file selection, it's never truly deleted. You can always recover it from the save file directory on your PC.

➤ Reworked the look of conveyor belts to make it easier to see which direction they're currently moving in.

➤ Updated text translations. Various small improvements and additions for many languages.

➤ Images in the [spoiler]secret presentation room[/spoiler] are automatically scaled to the correct size so you don't need to resize them manually anymore.

➤ If there happens to be a loading delay for any of the voice lines, the subtitle should no longer show up way too early.

➤ Removed two soft-locks where players could get stuck. One in [spoiler]the disco boss fight[/spoiler] and one in [spoiler]a basketball level where the player could end up in a hole to high to jump out of.[/spoiler] 

For Modding:
➤ I added a new branch that was not complied using YYC. You can reach it by right clicking on the game in your library / properties / betas / select "sandbox" branch. This version should be easier to decompile and modify. This branch might also help with stability in some cases if you're one of the few people struggling with game crashes. Curious to see what you create! :)

➤ I made a tutorial on how to recreate Squid's voice effect for those of you who are interested in making an audio language mod. :)

➤ Remember to check out the existing modding guides here.

Up next:
For the next patches I plan to tackle more of your feedback to keep improving the experience, so keep it coming! Once the game is in a state we're all happy with, we can start thinking about adding more content. Join us on Discord to stay up to date with the development and to participate in some fun community events! :)

Thanks so much for all the support! Snail on!
Jonas

notes.title: Preparing My Game For Release...
notes.notes:
🐌 It's Happening!🐌

The clock is ticking and the time left until Will You Snail? is released grows smaller.
[previewyoutube=Ry5egJ8BBOY;full][/previewyoutube]
You thought this game would never come out. Surprise, it's actually happening! (I'm kinda surprised as well. Lol.)

So, What's The Current Status?

Things are snailing along and nearly done! Lots of exciting stuff happening, including some mysterious announcements coming up in the near future...but you know, [strike]spoilers[/strike].

But in all seriousness, it's time to get this game out there! As much as I would like this game to be perfect, it's not. It has been many years in development and though it may not be the longest play-through in the world, and still possibly have some small bugs and such, I am super proud of how far the game has come and excited for all of you to try it!

It's not just the game to be excited about though! We've had some exciting developments in the community and there are still so many more to come. We now have a new Community Management Team onboard and are hanging out in the Discord, going to start some fun new stuff in the near future! 

Speaking of fun things, I'll make another reaction video from the things I find in our Community Discord and the Snail Subreddit soon, so now would be the time to jump on in if you have not already!

But I wont keep you here any longer, I mean as you saw if you watched the YouTube video...[strike]Dev life is SUPER busy and SUPER exciting[/strike]...So lots to get back to..ha..ha..

Thank you again to each and everyone of you for the love and support you constantly show to both me, and the general Dev Community. I am so happy to have such an amazing community behind me and this game!

Till Next Time,

Snail

Also...don't forget to join the Discord and make some fan art of snails or something...

Oh...and maybe follow the Twitter too, just in case you know🐌 : @JonasTyroller

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1115050/Will_You_Snail/

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Finally, a new devlog!
It's been over 9 months since the last update so there is a LOT to catch up on. Please let me know what you think about the new changes and have fun watching the video! :)

[previewyoutube=MaFpf3nmHmo;full][/previewyoutube]

What's New?
Here is a quick summary of the video above:

 I added a bunch of new dialog snippets to the game that you have to find and try to make sense of. Now you can finally learn a lot more about Squid and the Will You Snail universe (if you want to).
 Squid has facial animations now.
 There is a new more chill game mode you can play for killing some time or relaxing a little.
 A bunch of new tracks were added to the soundtrack.
 The colors of the game were reworked (AGAIN). There are multiple color schemes you can choose from in the menu now.
 I made a ton of other little changes like adding save slots, polishing, but fixing, hiding some more secrets, and... and... and...
 Translating a game with so much text is a massive pain for a small indie developer like me. Due to my lack of experience I made some pretty silly legal mistakes that caused both me as well as a lot of translators to lose a ton of progress. Pretty stupid and upsetting. Let's hope I learned my lesson.
 I'm super nervous about launching the game cause my time and resource investments are just getting way out of control at this point. Making the game will cost me at least $20,000 and I already invested over 3 years into the development. To be completely honest, it's absolutely scary to think about. Yikes.
 The release date got moved to Q1 2022. That should give me more time to fix the remaining bugs and do some proper marketing. What are a few months after 3 years anyways... and what are a few more months after that anyways... and what are a few more months after that anyways... and what are a few more months after that anyways... and what are a few more months after that anyways... For real, though, whatever state the game might be in early next year, you'll all get to play it! It's set into stone.

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello there,
I thought I'd give you a quick update on what I've been working on for the game! :)

Story Content

A lot of you wanted to learn more about the evil AI Squid and his past. I'm on that now, adding a bunch of story and secrets content (which makes these dev updates a little tricky, because I probably shouldn't spoil all of that before the game even comes out).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35367160/3808601d3dbaef703f14b72515248d16ee6adfb7.png

Working on story content is a super strange experience for me, as I've never done that for any of my games before. Not super sure how it's going as I haven't handed any of the new content over to the playtesters yet. Very nervous about that but I guess I'll have to do that soon.

So far I only know one thing: The story is pretty crazy and chaotic. Not sure if in a good way or in a bad way, but it's definitely something only I could have come up with... ehhhh.... :P

I decided to tell most of the story through simple text files you can read if you want to, but they are optional. The most important bits are told directly in game through Squid's voice lines and short story levels. You only find information in pieces so it's up to you to puzzle it together and figure out what's going on (if you care to find out).

I can already tell, that I definitely made some mistakes in the story department of the game, but that's material for a future development update after the release of the game when we know how everything played out. Remember, it's an indie game and we gotta finish this up this year so I'm taking some strategic compromises. For the most part, I think you will like it. :D


Almost Done

The good news is that the game is pretty much content complete now. That means: Most of the levels I want in the game are done, almost all of the 1150 voice lines are recorded and implemented, most things are working as they're supposed to. Even the polish of the game is at a point where I'm already fairly happy with it. It's pretty much done.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35367160/1fd2614a94aded5e3c4ad3a7d7c0fec4dac9143d.png

So what's left to do and when will the game come out? Weeeeell... I don't feel quite ready to announce a release date yet. I have an unannounced release date somewhere in October, but it's unannounced for a reason!! :D

Even when a game is basically done, often times it's actually not. We still gotta go through tons of bug fixing, implement some improvement suggestions from playtesters (especially testing the on-boarding experience some more to make sure new players will have a good time with the game), finish translating the texts to more languages and perhaps even translating the voice lines... if I manage to find an affordable way to do that for that many voice lines... yikes... and, and, and...

I also still want to reserve a reasonable amount of time just to focus on marketing before launch. As a solo dev every single thing you want to do takes up way more time than it's supposed to, so I'd expect the release in Q4 of 2021, but you know the drill... nothing is set into stone yet. All in all, I'd say the game is coming along very nicely, though, and I can't wait for you to finally try it.

Hey, if you haven't wishlisted Will You Snail yet, I'd really appreciate if you'd log into your Steam account real quick and hit that wishlist button for me. That way you'll get notified when the game comes out so you don't miss the launch. Great free way to support my work and should only take about 20 seconds. :)
